<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Repair two Clef-Omni boundaries on vLLM 0.32: retrying a cold image after schema refusal, and loading the full-width BF16 output lookup table with a ModelOpt NVFP4 backbone.

This targets `releases/v0.32.0` at `5df63a7203cdb9328d824a27b682e77c7b9928be`. The renderer repair and its test from the original PR head `33460c48` are unchanged.

## Claims

- Keep the existing `skip_mm_cache=True` call in `JointSchemaStrategy._render_media`, preventing a refused request from leaving sender-only media-cache state. Omni's state truncation and 64k reference cap remain unchanged.
- Represent Clef-Omni's required output lookup table with the existing `VocabParallelEmbedding`, matching its lookup-only role.
- Preserve the checkpoint parameter name, full tensor values, vocabulary layout, padding, dtype policy and tied-parameter identity. The untied output table remains distinct from the input embedding.
- Retain the original unbound lexical lookup. No required weights are skipped, reshaped or substituted; generic Qwen generation is unchanged.

## Validation

These are CPU results, not full-model native qualification.

| Comparison | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Original v0.32 renderer, identical cold-cache regression and three Omni controls | 3 passed, 1 failed with `MultiModalCacheMissError` |
| Existing renderer repair | 4 passed |
| Original Clef owner file, identical output-table tests and existing reference-pooler test | 8 failed, 4 passed |
| Updated Clef owner file | 12 passed, no failures, errors or skips |
| Separate diagnostic using retained checkpoint metadata | 12 passed; reproduces the named `lm_head` failure through the actual constructor and weight loader |

Renderer test selection:

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/entrypoints/generate/structured_decisions/test_strategies.py \
  -k 'cold_image_cache_survives_schema_refusal or joint_schema_truncates_the_state or joint_schema_reads_every_question_at_once or joint_schema_rejects_instructions'
```

Output-table test selection:

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/model_executor/test_clef_omni_output_embeddings.py \
  tests/models/multimodal/pooling/test_clef_omni.py
```

The recorded output-table comparison used an identity-checked pytest runner that pre-imported and hashed the selected source before running these files. Candidate and baseline used the same frozen tests; the commands above identify equivalent selections, not the complete historical runner invocation.

The renderer regression goes through FastAPI `/v1/systemone`, real `Qwen3OmniMoeProcessor`, `HfRenderer` and LRU sender/receiver caches. Model inference results are stubbed. It checks cold schema refusal, a fitting same-image retry, warm repetition and a distinct image. Removing only the skip flag reproduces the real receiver-cache failure.

The output-table controls exercise the real Clef and inner Omni constructors, ModelOpt parameter allocation, checkpoint-name mapping and `AutoWeightsLoader`. They cover different input/output values, hidden widths including 2048, vocabulary padding, TP2 shard layouts, tied parameters, wrong-width refusal, unchanged expert quantization dispatch and the existing lexical lookup through an unmapped LoRA wrapper. Decoder/tower computation, distributed transport and GPU-kernel selection are stubbed. The existing reference-pooler test is included.

Changed-file Ruff, formatting, mypy, test-tethering and the normal upstream pre-commit hooks passed. No hook was bypassed. Native startup, real checkpoint inference, GPU memory, model evaluation, activated LoRA and distributed forward were not run. No performance or model-fidelity improvement is claimed.

## Details

### Cold media retry

Media preprocessing can populate the sender cache before the complete question schema is rejected. A fitting retry of the same image can then send only a hash to a receiver that never received the tensor. The existing processor-only cache option prevents that premature sender trust. Repeated requests may resend tensor payloads; no throughput improvement is claimed.

### Output embedding load

The observed checkpoint stores both vocabulary tables as BF16 `[152064, 2048]`, but does not exclude `lm_head` from ModelOpt quantization. The inherited `ParallelLMHead` is treated as a linear layer and allocated at packed width 1024. The actual startup trace reports 1024 versus 2048 without a parameter name; the actual-metadata CPU loader reproduction identifies the output `lm_head`.

Clef consumes this table through embedding lookups, not logits projection. A plain `VocabParallelEmbedding` uses the existing embedding quantization dispatch and loads the full-width BF16 table under the same checkpoint name. It receives the same quantization configuration; there is no forced dtype or checkpoint rewrite.

Related [#62043](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62043) adds the missing Omni head prefix, but prefix-only does not repair this checkpoint because its exclusions do not name the head. A counterfactual head exclusion repairs allocation but leaves an unquantized linear method without the embedding lookup Clef requires. The related [vllm-omni #4528](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/pull/4528) concerns the separate vllm-omni repository.

The renderer repair is separate from Flash-only [#62249](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62249) and [#62297](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62297). Bounded open-PR searches did not establish another complete matching Clef output-table repair; this is not an exhaustive absence claim.

### Limits and tradeoffs

- The parent constructor allocates the old head before replacement. Transient allocation and the approximately 0.6 GB full BF16 table require native measurement.
- Qwen3-Omni's current head has no bias. A future biased head is not qualified by this replacement.
- TP2 loading layout is tested, not distributed forward or collectives.
- Activated head-LoRA behavior and type-based re-tying/deduplication optimizations are not qualified. The previous unbound lexical lookup is retained.
- A genuinely quantized output-table checkpoint is outside this BF16-table repair.

AI assistance (Codex) was used for implementation, source analysis and CPU testing. Source review was also AI-assisted. No human technical review, human-run tests or Claude-executed tests are claimed. The upstream human-accountability and native end-to-end validation requirements remain unmet; this draft does not claim they have been satisfied.

+
+from types import SimpleNamespace

+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.config.compilation import CompilationConfig, CompilationMode

+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import modelopt

+
+
+def _quant_config():
+    # The checkpoint excludes input embeddings but stores its output table as

+    config = {
+        "quant_method": "modelopt",
+        "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+        "config_groups": {
+            "group_0": {

+                "weights": {"num_bits": 4, "type": "float", "group_size": 16},
+                "targets": ["Linear"],
+            }
+        },

+def _tables(vocab_size, hidden_size):
+    cells = torch.arange(vocab_size * hidden_size).reshape(vocab_size, hidden_size)

+def _load_tables(model, input_table, output_table):

+    )

+def test_output_table_loads_and_lexical_uses_output_values(
+    make_model, quantized, hidden_size
+):
+    model, config = make_model(quantized=quantized, hidden_size=hidden_size)
+    input_table, output_table = _tables(65, hidden_size)
+    names = _load_tables(model, input_table, output_table)
+    assert names == {
+        "language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight",
+        "language_model.lm_head.weight",

+    table = model.language_model.lm_head
+    assert isinstance(table, vocab.VocabParallelEmbedding)
+    assert isinstance(table.quant_method, vocab.UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod)
+    assert table.params_dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert table.weight.shape == (128, hidden_size)
+    assert table.weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    torch.testing.assert_close(table.weight[:65], output_table)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(table.weight[65:], torch.zeros_like(table.weight[65:]))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        model.language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight[:65], input_table
+    )
+    tokens = torch.tensor([0, 3, 64])
+    actual = model._embed_lexical(tokens)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, F.embedding(tokens, output_table))
+    assert not torch.equal(actual, F.embedding(tokens, input_table))
+    assert model.secondary_weights[0].prefix == "pooler.head."
+    assert config.quant_config is model.quant_config
